scope: Ten further bounded review repairs. This does not certify all 39 findings, genuine portfolio activity or daily-use acceptance.
cross_cutting_reason: Shared financial contracts require coordinated API, calculation, ownership-context, presentation and regression changes across more than ten files.

first_release_followup.browser: Signed-in Today workspace reloaded successfully in the in-app browser. Read-only check; no research records changed.
fixes: Read-only Alembic inspection no longer enters the upgrade guard.
Browser evidence test checks receipt invalidation without overwriting an original source.
Source-page browser assertions target the visible route during navigation.

sets.outcome: Block arithmetic across incompatible or unknown accounting units
sets.behavior: Identity checks require finite operands with the same known scale and currency, retain the true unit label, and return a unit_issue instead of a misleading sum. Existing metrics are unchanged.

sets.outcome: Normalize percentage points using workbook format evidence
sets.behavior: Ordinary percentage-point values, including small, zero and negative values, divide by 100. Actual Excel percent-formatted fractions are preserved. Raw values, number formats and transformations remain in source locators.
sets.limit: Existing extractions are not silently reclassified.

sets.outcome: Reject invalid saved valuation inputs and non-finite calculations
sets.behavior: New writes bound canonical growth years, finite numeric growth and nonnegative equity-bridge claims. Preview and save withhold unsupported numeric results; failed saves roll back. Legacy responses add blocking diagnostics without rewriting stored inputs or outputs.
sets.limit: Missing input defaults elsewhere in the engine and exact historical exports remain separate open boundaries.

sets.outcome: Carry company classification through valuation guards
sets.behavior: Saved calculations, preview, quick calculation, draft promotion, scenarios, sensitivity and reverse DCF receive company sector/industry context. Financial-sector FCFF writes are blocked, legacy reads are flagged, and the dedicated equity model remains supported.
Interest-rate contribution is minus duration times the rate shock; other macro coefficients retain their existing signs. The UI explains decimal shock units and direction.

original_source.observation: The stored D-column slope and duration have opposite signs. Original workbook bytes were not modified.

sets.outcome: Validate WACC units, capital and horizon
sets.behavior: Pure contracts require finite bounded decimal rates, nonnegative capital with a positive finite total, and a valid fade/projection horizon. Invalid capital no longer invents a fully equity-funded company. Existing public imports remain compatible.

sets.outcome: Replay financial corrections against complete recorded history
sets.behavior: Notes-only edits leave balances and dates unchanged. Financial edits/deletions lock affected portfolios, reconcile current positions/cash with the old ledger, simulate the corrected chronology, then update atomically. Unsupported openings, oversells and unfunded activity are rejected. Old snapshots are never rewritten.
sets.limit: Recorded history is not broker-verified. Same-day ordering follows record IDs; incomplete opening history blocks financial correction. Backdated new posting remains a separate workflow.

sets.outcome: Preserve the currency of historical return calculations
sets.behavior: Historical cash flows use the selected snapshot currency, not a later preference. Mixed or invalid snapshot currencies withhold comparisons. Return responses expose the calculation currency.

sets.outcome: Withhold benchmarks with stale quote or FX evidence
sets.behavior: Boundary and flow-date quotes and required FX must be within five calendar days. Responses retain dates, ages and source IDs; the performance panel exposes calculation sources.
sets.limit: Five calendar days is an explicit policy, not an exchange-calendar claim. A3-9 return-method alignment remains open.

sets.behavior: Any missing or non-finite holding weight withholds weighted exposures, concentration and top-position rankings. Missing tickers and coverage state are explicit; no zero substitution or renormalization is applied.
